scope: Behavior, ARIA, parts, events and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test): top layer attributes, inert outside, scroll lock, focus in and back, Escape / outside press / close reasons, nesting; the headless modal layer (dom/dialog.ts); the React renderer's server markup and client behavior. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: preset and parts anatomy, popup ARIA, trigger press / Escape / outside press / close part with Base UI reasons (cancelable openchange), modal / trap-focus / false, inert outside and scroll lock (counted, undone on removal), focus in ([autofocus]) and back to the trigger, nested dialogs, no native form elements
resolveDialog: card-xl padding inside B, radius = padding × min(1, s), 2u gap (the gap attribute wins), 96u width within the 4u viewport margin

React SSR: the same data-* and recipe classes as the web component, kit Button trigger and close, the composed parts render the preset, render and className functions; client: trigger press, Escape and close part reasons, inert outside, focus in and back, controlled open

limitations: The top layer (popover), the enter and exit transitions and real focus movement need a real browser; unit tests cover the attributes and calls they key on.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []), the open popups and their parts compared part by part.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio on the Components page Overlays family at u = 3, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, light and dark): growth (long content scrolls inside the popup once it reaches the viewport less 4u; a narrow viewport narrows the popup to the viewport less 8u; actions wrap), RTL (dir=rtl: the popup stays centered, the actions row sits at the inline end, text aligns to the start; all insets are logical), focus (the trigger, close and field rings are outlines and change no dimension; focus is trapped in the popup and returns to the trigger), nested dialog (no second backdrop, the parent steps back), screenshots of the Overlays family checked light and dark.
